numbering_status: vulgate_gallican -- this IS the Roman Breviary's native psalm numbering (the pre-Vatican-II Breviary always used Vulgate/Gallican numbers, never the Hebrew/modern numbering). Confirmed directly: chapter 5 verse 1 is the psalm's Latin inscription/title ("In finem, pro ea quae haereditatem consequitur. Psalmus David."), verses 2+ are the numbered body -- and verse 2 ("Verba mea auribus percipe, Domine...") matches the antiphon already appointed in manifests/2026.json's Nocturnus I verbatim. No cross-numbering conversion needed for this lane; the prior 'not yet normalized' status on the individual psalm-appointment rows in bible-bindings/dev-vertical-slice.json can be resolved once that report is regenerated against this import.
